title: Horned Wizard in Cosmic Ruins
description: A blue-skinned demonic figure with large curved horns stands at the center of an ancient stone archway. He wears a long Victorian coat over a vest, glowing blue energy emanates from his hands and head as he looks directly forward, surrounded by a massive gnarled tree with glowing crystals, floating runes, and a swirling cosmic nebula sky.
prompt: A blue-skinned horned demon wizard with glowing cyan eyes and hands stands powerfully in the center of a broken stone archway covered in glowing runes. He wears a long Victorian coat with purple lining, vest, and boots. A massive ancient twisted tree with glowing blue crystals grows through the ruins on the left. Cosmic nebula and starry sky swirl in the background with floating magical particles and footprints on the stone floor.
